Bitwarden vs 1Password for emergency access (2026)

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026

Short answer: For emergency access, Bitwarden wins. Its built-in Emergency Access lets trusted contacts request View or Takeover access, granted when you approve or after a wait time you set. 1Password has no equivalent; you rely on a printed Emergency Kit and, on family plans, an organiser who can recover a member's account.

Key facts

  • Verdict: Choose Bitwarden if you want a tested, automatic emergency-access process.
  • Bitwarden: Free plan available; Emergency Access requires Premium or a paid Families/Teams/Enterprise plan. Check current pricing.
  • 1Password: Paid plans only (free trial). Check current pricing.

Which should you choose?

Verdict: Choose Bitwarden if you want a tested, automatic emergency-access process. Choose 1Password only if you'll store the Emergency Kit safely (with your account password written in) and use a Families plan with two organisers.

Frequently asked questions

Bitwarden vs 1Password for emergency access: which is better?

For emergency access, Bitwarden wins. Its built-in Emergency Access lets trusted contacts request View or Takeover access, granted when you approve or after a wait time you set. 1Password has no equivalent; you rely on a printed Emergency Kit and, on family plans, an organiser who can recover a member's account.

Does 1Password have emergency access?

Not as an automatic feature. 1Password's Emergency Kit is a PDF with your sign-in details and a space for your password, which you can give to someone you trust. Family organisers can also recover family members' accounts.

How does Bitwarden emergency access work?

You invite a trusted contact and choose View or Takeover access. When they request access, you can approve or reject it; otherwise access is granted after the wait time you set.

Is Bitwarden emergency access free?

Adding trusted contacts needs Premium or a paid organisation plan, but the contact only needs a free Bitwarden account on the same server.

Can a 1Password family organiser get into my vault after I die?

An organiser can begin recovery, but you must confirm by email and create a new password, so on its own it's not a death-planning tool. Pair it with a stored Emergency Kit.
